speaker: say5
text: A handoff to the running back, who runs between the guards and picks the hole that opens. Steady gains against two deep defenders; weak when many defenders crowd the line.
note: description of O001 Inside Zone (NX-P8; heard with D)

speaker: say5
text: A fast handoff straight ahead through the middle. It gains a short, sure yard or two against a blitz, but loses ground when defenders crowd the line.
note: description of O005 Dive (NX-P8; heard with D)

speaker: say5
text: The quarterback fakes a pass, then hands the ball off. Works against a blitz; weak when many defenders wait near the line or a defender stays back.
note: description of O004 Draw Play (NX-P8; heard with D)

speaker: say5
text: A handoff up the middle while a blocker cuts across to stop the defender coming from behind. Good against a thin defense; extra rushers can stop it.
note: description of O053 Split Zone (NX-P8; heard with D)

text: A run just outside the guard, with blockers moving sideways together and the runner choosing a hole. Good against two deep defenders; defenders slanting across the line spoil it.
note: description of O054 Mid Zone (NX-P8; heard with D)

speaker: say5
text: The quarterback fakes a pass, waits a moment, then hands off. Works against a blitz; weak when a defender stays back to watch the runner.
note: description of O055 Delayed Draw (NX-P8; heard with D)

speaker: say5
text: A fake pass, then a handoff to a runner with a big back leading the way. Strong against a blitz; stopped when many defenders crowd the line.
note: description of O056 Lead Draw (NX-P8; heard with D)

speaker: say5
text: A surprise blocker hits the middle defender while the runner goes up the middle. Beats extra rushers; weak against big defenders who hold their ground.
note: description of O057 Wham (NX-P8; heard with D)

speaker: say5
text: A handoff with the runner following a lead blocker just off the middle. Good against a thin defense; weak when the defense squeezes the line tight.
note: description of O058 Belly (NX-P8; heard with D)

speaker: say5
text: A short handoff straight ahead to a big running back, mostly for one yard near the goal line. Reliable against a blitz; stops when defenders crowd the line.
note: description of O059 Fullback Dive (NX-P8; heard with D)

speaker: say5
text: Linemen run to the side to lead the way and the runner follows them. Strong against a thin defense; defenders slanting into the hole can stop it.
note: description of O002 Power Left (NX-P8; heard with D)

speaker: say5
text: The play starts one way, then the blockers and the runner cut back the other way. Beats rushers who chase the first move; weak against defenders who stay wide.
note: description of O003 Counter (NX-P8; heard with D)

speaker: say5
text: One blocker clears a defender and the runner follows straight into the hole. Good against two deep defenders; extra rushers stop it.
note: description of O006 Iso (NX-P8; heard with D)

speaker: say5
text: A defender is let through on purpose and hit from the side while the runner goes up the middle. Beats rushers; weak against big defenders who hold their ground.
note: description of O007 Trap (NX-P8; heard with D)

speaker: say5
text: A running back leads the way and the runner follows him through the hole. Good against a thin defense; weak when defenders crowd the line.
note: description of O008 Lead Run (NX-P8; heard with D)

speaker: say5
text: Two blockers push the same defender apart while the runner picks a hole. Good against two deep defenders; extra rushers can break it up.

speaker: say5
text: Like the counter, with two linemen leading the runner back against the flow. Beats extra rushers; weak when defenders stay wide.
note: description of O061 Counter Trey (NX-P8; heard with D)

speaker: say5
text: A big back runs through the middle behind a surprise block. Beats extra rushers; weak when defenders crowd the line.
note: description of O062 Fullback Trap (NX-P8; heard with D)

speaker: say5
text: A run toward the outer side of the line. Good against a thin defense; weak when the defense squeezes the line in.
note: description of O063 Off Tackle (NX-P8; heard with D)

speaker: say5
text: The runner heads outside, then cuts back against the flow. Good against defenders who slant to one side; weak against big defenders who hold the middle.

speaker: say5
text: The line moves sideways, the runner heads toward the sideline, then turns up the field. Good against two deep defenders; defenders who stay wide stop it.

speaker: say5
text: Blockers all move toward the sideline and the runner picks a lane. Good against a thin defense; weak against defenders who stay wide.
note: description of O010 Outside Zone (NX-P8; heard with D)

text: The quarterback tosses the ball to a running back who runs wide behind blockers. Works when the middle is crowded; weak against defenders who stay wide.

text: A quick toss to a running back running wide. Beats a blitz; weak against defenders who stay wide.

text: A very fast toss to the running back moving toward the sideline. Beats extra rushers; weak against defenders who stay wide.
note: description of O065 Quick Toss (NX-P8; heard with D)

text: A toss wide while a receiver blocks inside on the first defender. Works when the middle is crowded; weak against defenders who stay wide.
note: description of O066 Crack Toss (NX-P8; heard with D)

text: Some linemen block the nearest defenders while others run ahead to lead the runner around the end. Good against a thin defense; slanting defenders can stop it.

text: Two linemen run ahead of the runner around the end. Good against two deep defenders; extra rushers break it up.
